source.title: Ashenvale Mission V: Satyr Intelligence
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Satyrnaar. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Mandoran there and return to me.
source.objective: Gather intelligence from Dreamwarden Mandoran in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursion at the ritual circle in Satyrnaar and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
